remedySafetyCharter: All remedies are strictly ethical, safe, free or low-cost, respectful of living beings, and never substitute professional medical, legal, or psychiatric assistance.

Sun.title: Surya Arghya with Copper Vessel
Sun.practice: Offer fresh clean water in a copper pot toward the rising Sun within one hour of sunrise, practicing gratitude.

Sun.title: Jaggery & Wheat Sharing
Sun.practice: Share natural jaggery and roasted wheat grains with birds or animals.

Moon.title: Solid Silver Square Piece
Moon.practice: Keep a small solid pure silver square token in your wallet or locker to ground emotional volatility.

Moon.title: Mother's Morning Charan Sparsh
Moon.practice: Touch the feet of mother or maternal elders in the morning and receive their heartfelt blessings.

Mars.title: Pure Honey in Silver/Earthen Pot
Mars.practice: Keep pure wild honey in a clean small earthen pot in the quiet north corner of the home.

Mars.title: Sweet Fennel & Batasha Offering
Mars.practice: Share sweet fennel seeds (saunf) and sugar batashas with children on Tuesdays.

Mercury.title: Soaked Whole Green Moong for Birds
Mercury.practice: Soak whole green moong dal overnight and feed to pigeons or wild birds at dawn on Wednesday.

Mercury.title: Pure Copper Pierced Coin in Running Water
Mercury.practice: Gently drop a traditional unpunched copper coin into clean flowing river water.

Jupiter.title: Saffron & Turmeric Tilak
Jupiter.practice: Apply a subtle dot of natural yellow saffron or organic turmeric paste on the forehead and navel.

Jupiter.title: Yellow Chana Dal for Desi Cow
Jupiter.practice: Offer soaked yellow chana dal and fresh green grass to cows on Thursday mornings.

Venus.title: Natural Camphor (Kapur) Aromatherapy
Venus.practice: Diffuse natural pure camphor in a clay bowl to cleanse household atmosphere and elevate serenity.

Venus.title: Respect & Harmony with Life Partner
Venus.practice: Speak with gentle speech, present flowers or natural scents to spouse, and cultivate marital gratitude.

Saturn.title: Chhaya Daan in Mustard Oil
Saturn.practice: Look into a bowl of pure mustard oil, see your reflection, and offer the oil for lighting temple lamps or helping laborers.

Saturn.title: Mustard Roti for Stray Dogs
Saturn.practice: Offer fresh homemade rotis lightly coated with mustard oil to friendly stray dogs.

Rahu.title: Barley (Jau) Grains in Flowing Stream
Rahu.practice: Rinse whole barley grains with raw milk and release into running fresh water.

Rahu.title: Organize Clutter & Broken Electronics
Rahu.practice: Clear all broken clocks, frayed wires, and disused electronics from the home to clear negative perceptual distortion.

Ketu.title: Two-Tone Sesame & Jaggery Grains
Ketu.practice: Feed roasted black and white sesame seeds mixed with jaggery to ants or birds in garden soil.

Ketu.title: Donate Warm Black-and-White Blanket
Ketu.practice: Gift a clean warm two-color blanket to someone sleeping exposed to cold weather.
